mode: The user goal/result checkpoints below are the default manual mode. Explicit Plan mode:auto may use auto.json and lifecycle.authorizeAutoGoal/acceptAutoDelivery with actual Plan delegation. This changes only the authority receipt path; it never bypasses Work, scope, typed outputs, source/evidence validation or reserved human choices.

entry.scope: plan.json: present complete scope and wait for actual subsequent user approval

completion.preflight: Before presenting result acceptance, preflightCompletion must predict complete proof for exactly the selected leaves without writes. Fix missing assertions/evidence before asking the user; changed results still require a new receipt.
completion.evidencePublication: Stage and seal in .starciwork/_local/evidence-staging, excluded from canonical Work, validate with previewEvidence, publish a fresh complete directory with workflows/evidence.mjs. Never update bytes beneath an existing manifest; preserved hashes must continue to describe actual bytes.

approvalTrust: Receipts must come from actual user messages. This local validator binds receipts but cannot authenticate a human; the coordinator must never fabricate approvals.

explicitFlash.selection: Only explicit per-request flash with eligible local scope; never fabricate Plan approval or a workflow completion receipt.
